method: Fetched full text of all 16 pack files from GitHub main, extracted each quoted Base64 payload, concatenated in numeric order, independently decoded all Base64 bytes, and computed SHA-256 in pure JavaScript using FIPS 180-4 message padding, prime-derived round constants and 64-round compression; compared resulting digest with previously recorded manifest expected gzip SHA-256.
limitations: Original SHP, v102/v129, 3D elevation, DEM and audit ZIP bytes unavailable in current execution; source ZIP SHA256 remains a reference only
No gzip decompression, uncompressed CRC32/raw JSON SHA256, graph feature parsing, individual geometry, 35m legal evidence, v69 route regression or deployment validation
